pipican.ore.electrum.note: Set: very light, fast mining, strong magic affinity; low durability.
pipican.ore.cold_iron.note: Set: +50% damage to fey and spirits; armor shortens curses.
pipican.ore.truesilver.note: Set: bonus damage to undead; the helmet gives night vision.
pipican.ore.corundum.note: Set: a balanced starter set; also the binder in alloys.
pipican.ore.cinnabar.note: Smelts into Mercury, an alchemy and potion reagent.
pipican.ore.amber.note: Lengthens potions; a vessel for sealing spells.
pipican.ore.tin.note: Allomancy: ground into flakes for Tin (and Pewter).
pipican.ore.stormsilver.note: Set: quick strikes; hits in rain are faster.
pipican.ore.runic_iron.note: Set: rune-etched balanced set with a little magic affinity.
pipican.ore.redrock_iron.note: Set: sturdy starter armor for the badlands.
pipican.ore.pearlsilver.note: Set: light sea-diver set; faster swimming.
pipican.ore.frostcrystal.note: Frost reagent: cold potions and slowing arrows.
pipican.ore.tideglass.note: Sea glass: water breathing brews and clear windows.
pipican.ore.sunglass.note: Desert glass lens: focuses sunlight, crafts lanterns.
pipican.ore.verdantite.note: Growth stone: a strong fertilizer for crops and trees.
pipican.ore.moonstone.note: Set: damage and speed bonus at night, neutral by day.
pipican.ore.demonite.note: Set: high crit chance; brief invisibility in darkness.
pipican.ore.machalite.note: Set: bonus damage to large creatures and bosses.
pipican.ore.bloodstone.note: Blood magic catalyst: imbues a weapon with life steal.
pipican.ore.sunstone.note: Stores daylight: a lantern block that keeps undead away.
pipican.ore.aquamarine.note: Water and rune magic focus; a staff crystal.
pipican.ore.night_jade.note: Glows at night: decoration and a trade good.
pipican.ore.zinc.note: Allomancy: ground into flakes for Zinc (and Brass).
pipican.ore.glacierite.note: Set: frost tank; resists cold and slows attackers.
pipican.ore.cinderite.note: Set: ember-forged; fire resistance and burning hits.
pipican.ore.tidalite.note: Set: tidecaller set; strong in and near water.
pipican.ore.thunderbasalt.note: Stores lightning: storm rods and charged blocks.
pipican.ore.mooncrystal.note: Moonlit crystal: night vision lenses and night potions.
pipican.ore.jade_essence.note: Healing essence: restorative brews and charms.
pipican.ore.cobalt.note: Set: the fastest mining of its tier.
pipican.ore.ardite.note: Set: very durable but slow; armor gives fire resistance.
pipican.ore.thorium.note: Set: heavy armor, immune to knockback.
pipican.ore.malachite.note: Set: light armor with dodge chance; tools are very sharp but brittle.
pipican.ore.quicksilver.note: Set: the highest movement and attack speed.
pipican.ore.hellstone.note: Set: fire immunity; hits set the target ablaze.
pipican.ore.fel_iron.note: Set: strong fire damage, but a slow curse hurts the wearer.
pipican.ore.dwemer_metal.note: Set: mechanical; tools smelt ore as they mine, armor resists traps.
pipican.ore.thaumium.note: Set: a mage set; abilities cost less.
pipican.ore.manasteel.note: Set: tools repair themselves with mana.
pipican.ore.dragonglass.note: Daggers and arrowheads against ice creatures and undead lords; brittle.
pipican.ore.thunderstone.note: Lightning imbue for weapons; the core of a lightning staff.
pipican.ore.enor_pearl.note: Precious jewelry and NPC trade good.
pipican.ore.vespene.note: Geyser fuel for furnaces and machines.
pipican.ore.cadmium.note: Allomancy: ground into flakes for Cadmium (and Bendalloy).
pipican.ore.wintersteel.note: Set: cold-forged; frost damage and cold immunity.
pipican.ore.royal_silver.note: Set: noble silver; undead bane and better trades.
pipican.ore.dawnbronze.note: Set: holy bronze; strong by day.
pipican.ore.mirestone.note: Bog stone: poison cures and swamp waders.
pipican.ore.saffron_gold.note: Spice-coast gold: trade currency and luxury goods.
pipican.ore.meteoric_iron.note: Set: bonus damage to monsters; falls to the world in meteor events.
pipican.ore.elementium.note: Set: the weapon element (fire, ice, lightning) can be switched.
pipican.ore.iridium.note: Set: tools mine 3x3; the most durable armor of its tier.
pipican.ore.carbalite.note: Set: tank; bonus when blocking with a shield.
pipican.ore.black_metal.note: Set: shield warrior; heavy weapon damage.
pipican.ore.starsilver.note: Set: frost damage and cold immunity.
pipican.ore.celestial_bronze.note: Set: hurts only monsters and the supernatural; a PvE set.
pipican.ore.imperial_gold.note: Set: a leadership buff for nearby allies.
pipican.ore.goblin_silver.note: Set: repairs itself; the weapon absorbs traits of what it slays (e.g. poison).
pipican.ore.dimeritium.note: Set: nearly immune to magic, but the wearer can't cast; a mage hunter set.
pipican.ore.magisteel.note: Set: grows stronger with its owner's mana as it is used.
pipican.ore.kyanite.note: Depth and pressure module for equipment.
pipican.ore.starmetal.note: Constellation attunement: a passive bonus for your class.
pipican.ore.kairoseki.note: Suppresses magic: shackles, mage-hunter coatings, prison blocks.
pipican.ore.sekkiseki.note: Blocks magic and teleportation: a building block.
pipican.ore.eco.note: Coloured energy: green heals, blue speeds, red strengthens, yellow reaches.
pipican.ore.raritanium.note: Weapon upgrade material: replaces a boss core at any blacksmith. Falls with meteors.
pipican.ore.evolution_stone.note: Class advancement token: Novice to Expert.
pipican.ore.chromium.note: Allomancy: ground into flakes for Chromium.
pipican.ore.nickel.note: Allomancy: alloyed with chromium into Nicrosil.
pipican.ore.mithril.note: Set: light as a feather; heavy-armor protection with no speed penalty.
pipican.ore.ebony.note: Set: high physical damage; stealth bonus in the dark.
pipican.ore.stalhrim.note: Set: hits freeze; frost magic grows stronger.
pipican.ore.eternium.note: Set: barely wears; loses durability very slowly.
pipican.ore.saronite.note: Set: very high power, but draws the undead.
pipican.ore.runite.note: Set: strong and balanced; only found in dangerous places.
pipican.ore.titanium.note: Set: a brief shield after taking damage.
pipican.ore.hallowed.note: Set: undead bane; brief invulnerability after being hit.
pipican.ore.stygian_iron.note: Set: absorbs the souls of what it strikes; raises undead.
pipican.ore.luna_titanium.note: Set: mech-style heavy armor; high protection, low speed.
pipican.ore.dragonite.note: Set: bonus damage to dragons and fire resistance.
pipican.ore.scarlet.note: Set: extra damage to demons and undead; the blade takes its owner's class colour.
pipican.ore.crystallite.note: Set: a light swordmaster set; combos deal more damage.
pipican.ore.gromril.note: Set: the highest armor of its tier, and heavy.
pipican.ore.ithilmar.note: Set: very light; an archer and speed set.
pipican.ore.carbonadium.note: Set: almost unbreakable; hits cause fatigue.
pipican.ore.octiron.note: Magic compass: points to the nearest source of magic or rare ore.
pipican.ore.titanite.note: Universal upgrade material: replaces any region's material at a blacksmith.
pipican.ore.zonaite.note: Fuses onto a tool at an anvil: +25% mining speed.
pipican.ore.hextech.note: Core for grappling hooks, jetpacks and energy weapons.
pipican.ore.warpstone.note: Chaos fuel; carry it and hostile creatures near you mutate.
pipican.ore.tiberium.note: Valuable but toxic: spreads into the stone around it and poisons what comes near.
pipican.ore.silversheen.note: Weapon coating: gives any weapon the properties of silver.
pipican.ore.aluminum.note: Allomancy: ground into flakes for Aluminum (and Duralumin).
pipican.ore.umbrite.note: Set: shadow-forged; stealth and damage from the dark.
pipican.ore.skycrystal.note: Sky crystal: levitation charms and floating platforms.
pipican.ore.lifebloom_crystal.note: Living crystal: powerful healing and regrowth.
pipican.ore.abyssal_shard.note: Abyssal shard: deep-sea breathing and pressure resistance.
pipican.ore.orichalcum.note: Set: balanced magic and might; water breathing.
pipican.ore.chlorophyte.note: Set: the ore grows into the stone around it; regeneration and strong bows.
pipican.ore.aetherium.note: Set: raises magic power; an artifact crown piece.
pipican.ore.gundanium.note: Set: hard for creatures to notice; very heavy and durable.
pipican.ore.inertron.note: Set: nearly immune to knockback and physical damage.
pipican.ore.sigmarite.note: Set: immune to demon and undead damage.
pipican.ore.phrik.note: Set: high resistance to energy weapons.
pipican.ore.trinium.note: Set: very light yet many times stronger than steel.
pipican.ore.flametal.note: Set: walk on lava; fire immunity.
pipican.ore.allthemodium.note: Set: the first link of the Allthemodium, Vibranium, Unobtanium chain.
pipican.ore.kryptonite.note: Boss weakener: weakens strong creatures nearby, and tires its carrier.
pipican.ore.cortosis.note: Shield coating: snuffs out energy weapons on contact.
pipican.ore.element_zero.note: Gravity well: right-click to pull creatures in and lift them. Falls with meteors.
pipican.ore.dilithium.note: Fast travel: right-click to return to your respawn point.
pipican.ore.quantanium.note: Unstable: explodes 5 minutes after you pick it up unless refined in a blast furnace.
pipican.ore.eridium.note: Rare upgrade currency: replaces a rare trophy at any blacksmith.
pipican.ore.adamantine.note: Set: unbreakable; its tools mine every ore in the game.
pipican.ore.hihiirokane.note: Set: never rusts, glows like fire; fire damage and constant light.
pipican.ore.darksteel.note: Set: tools and armor that never break.
pipican.ore.beskar.note: Set: resists magic and energy weapons; never dropped on death.
pipican.ore.nth_metal.note: Set: defies gravity; gliding and no fall damage.
pipican.ore.vibranium.note: Set: absorbs kinetic energy and releases it as a shockwave.
pipican.ore.katchin.note: An unworkable, unbreakable block: fortress walls and boss arenas.
pipican.ore.sam.note: Dimensional storage: right-click to open your ender chest anywhere.
pipican.ore.elerium.note: Fuel for the highest-grade energy weapons.
pipican.ore.prismatic_shard.note: Universal catalyst: rainbow weapons of every element.
pipican.ore.promethium.note: Endless energy: powers a whole base or city.
pipican.ore.atium.note: Allomancy god metal: see seconds of your foes' future.
pipican.ore.harmonium.note: Allomancy god metal: explodes on contact with water.
pipican.ore.uru.note: Set: stores magic and calls lightning; only the worthy can wield it.
pipican.ore.adamantium.note: Set: the highest damage reduction in the game, fully unbreakable. A boss drop.
pipican.ore.draconium.note: Set: a regenerating energy shield and flight.
pipican.ore.luminite.note: Set: a separate variant for each of four classes.
pipican.ore.phazon.note: Set: immense power and constant corruption; wear it too long and hostile creatures spawn.
pipican.ore.pale.note: The final upgrade: replaces any blacksmith material. Only 6 exist per world.
pipican.ore.chaos_emerald.note: Seven are scattered over the world; with all seven, right-click for a 30-second super form.
pipican.ore.trellium.note: Allomancy god metal: hides you from all tracking and detection.
pipican.ore.unobtanium.note: Set: the strongest in the game; only one full set per server.
pipican.ore.philosophers_stone.note: Transmutes the ore material in your off hand one tier up; the price is 2 max health, for good. Only one exists.
pipican.ore.lerasium.note: Allomancy: single use - lets you burn every metal for good (Mistborn).
pipican.ore.tamashigane.note: Soul steel: one piece per player, forged into a sword and armor bound to them.
pipican.ore.manyullyn.note: Cobalt + Ardite alloy. Set: high critical damage.
pipican.ore.arcanite.note: Thorium + Lacrima alloy. Set: magic damage bonus.
pipican.ore.terrasteel.note: Manasteel + Elementium alloy. Set: tool swings send an energy wave.
pipican.ore.daedric.note: Ebony + a demon heart. Set: the highest physical damage; wearing it costs max health.
pipican.ore.malatium.note: Atium + gold. Allomancy: shows a target's past - its weakness, class and secrets.
pipican.ore.valyrian_steel.note: Weapons only (sword, axe, dagger); can be reforged but never made. Found in ancient ruins.
pipican.ore.mega_stone.note: Expert to Master class advancement token. A boss drop.
pipican.ore.skyiron.note: Set: steppe-forged sky iron; light armor, swift mounted strikes.
pipican.ore.lotus_opal.note: Delta gem: jewelry, trade and calming charms.
pipican.ore.runestone.note: Rare deposit: rune inscriptions for blacksmith upgrades.
pipican.ore.sunforged.note: Rare deposit: sun-forged crystal for blacksmith upgrades.
pipican.ore.moonshard.note: Rare deposit: moonlit shard for blacksmith upgrades.
pipican.ore.soulstone.note: Rare deposit: holds souls; blacksmith upgrades and soul magic.
pipican.ore.abyssium.note: Rare deposit: abyssal crystal for blacksmith upgrades.
pipican.ore.astralite.note: Rare deposit: star crystal from the sky islands, for blacksmith upgrades.
pipican.ore.primordial.note: Rare deposit: crystal from before the world; the strongest blacksmith upgrades.
pipican.ore.mercury.note: Alchemy reagent: brewed into a potion, it makes the potion stronger (like glowstone).

pipican.ore.iron_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_iron.note: Allomancy - drink to burn iron: Pulls nearby metal items and metal-armored creatures toward you.
pipican.ore.steel_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_steel.note: Allomancy - drink to burn steel: Pushes on metal: jump in mid-air above metal to launch upward; your arrows hit harder.
pipican.ore.tin_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_tin.note: Allomancy - drink to burn tin: Sharpened senses: night vision, and creatures around you glow.
pipican.ore.pewter_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_pewter.note: Allomancy - drink to burn pewter: Strength, toughness and balance.
pipican.ore.copper_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_copper.note: Allomancy - drink to burn copper: A copper cloud: hides your burning from others; creatures notice you later.
pipican.ore.bronze_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_bronze.note: Allomancy - drink to burn bronze: Senses other players burning metals nearby.
pipican.ore.zinc_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_zinc.note: Allomancy - drink to burn zinc: Rioting: hostile creatures around you turn on each other.
pipican.ore.brass_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_brass.note: Allomancy - drink to burn brass: Soothing: creatures around you lose interest in you.
pipican.ore.cadmium_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_cadmium.note: Allomancy - drink to burn cadmium: A slow-time bubble: everything around you is slowed.
pipican.ore.bendalloy_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_bendalloy.note: Allomancy - drink to burn bendalloy: A speed bubble: you and allies nearby move, work and heal fast.
pipican.ore.gold_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_gold.note: Allomancy - drink to burn gold: Shows your past: where you last died.
pipican.ore.electrum_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_electrum.note: Allomancy - drink to burn electrum: Glimpses of your own future: 25% chance to dodge attacks.
pipican.ore.chromium_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_chromium.note: Allomancy - drink to burn chromium: Your hits wipe the target: its buffs, and a player's burning metals.
pipican.ore.nicrosil_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_nicrosil.note: Allomancy - drink to burn nicrosil: Touch an ally (right-click) to flare them: strength, speed and longer burns.
pipican.ore.aluminum_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_aluminum.note: Allomancy - drink to burn aluminum: Drinking it wipes all your burning metals and every effect on you.
pipican.ore.duralumin_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_duralumin.note: Allomancy - drink to burn duralumin: Drinking it flares everything you burn at triple strength for 5 seconds, then burns it out.
pipican.ore.malatium_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_malatium.note: Allomancy - drink to burn malatium: Hit a creature to see its past: its weakness, and you deal 20% more damage to it.
pipican.ore.atium_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_atium.note: Allomancy - drink to burn atium: See your foes' future: 85% chance to dodge attacks.
pipican.ore.trellium_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.ore.vial_of_trellium.note: Allomancy - drink to burn trellium: Hidden from all tracking: creatures farther than 4 blocks can't find you.
pipican.ore.nickel_flakes.note: Allomancy: mix into a vial with a glass bottle.
pipican.allomancy.mistborn: The Lerasium burns through you: you are Mistborn, and can burn every metal at once.
pipican.allomancy.aluminum: Aluminum: everything you burned is gone.
pipican.allomancy.gold: Gold shows your past: you last died at %s %s %s (%s).
pipican.allomancy.gold.none: Gold shows your past: you have never died.
pipican.allomancy.bronze: Bronze: you sense %s Allomancer(s) burning nearby.
pipican.allomancy.malatium: Malatium reveals %s: %s/%s health, %s armor. You strike it harder now.
pipican.soul.stage.1.desc: A plain, nameless blade and a plain black kimono.
pipican.soul.stage.2.desc: More damage and protection; sneak with the blade to sense souls through walls.
pipican.soul.stage.3.desc: The path's first ability; the armor takes the path's colours.
pipican.soul.stage.4.desc: The blade whispers its name - rename it on an anvil to give it your own.
pipican.soul.stage.5.desc: Trial: defeat the blade's spirit. The blade takes its first form and its main ability.
pipican.soul.stage.6.desc: Shikai hits harder and reaches farther; the armor's passive bonus.
pipican.soul.stage.7.desc: Second trial. Bankai: 60 seconds, 10 minutes to recover; the armor takes its full form.
pipican.soul.stage.8.desc: Bankai lasts 90 seconds and recovers in 5 minutes.
pipican.soul.stage.9.desc: Blade and wielder are one soul: +25% to every ability; the path's aura is always on.
pipican.soul.stage.10.desc: The path's ultimate, once a day (sneak + use during Bankai).
pipican.soul.path.black_crescent.s3: Swing a crescent of energy that cuts everything in a line.
pipican.soul.path.black_crescent.s5: The blade becomes a huge guardless cleaver: a wider, stronger crescent.
pipican.soul.path.black_crescent.s7: A slim black blade and blinding speed; black crescents in quick succession.
pipican.soul.path.black_crescent.s10: The inner beast wakes: a bone mask, crimson crescents and great strength for 30 seconds.
pipican.soul.path.black_crescent.aura: Black soul flames; you strike faster.
pipican.soul.path.ash_sovereign.s3: The blade catches fire: your hits burn for 15 seconds.
pipican.soul.path.ash_sovereign.s5: A wave of flame that burns everything it touches.
pipican.soul.path.ash_sovereign.s7: The flames draw into the blade: searing heat around you, and the foes you kill rise as a skeleton army.
pipican.soul.path.ash_sovereign.s10: The sun blade: one strike that turns everything before you to ash.
pipican.soul.path.ash_sovereign.armor: An ash-grey robe with burnt edges: fire can't hurt you.
pipican.soul.path.perfect_lie.s3: A false clone: you vanish for a moment and creatures lose sight of you.
pipican.soul.path.perfect_lie.s5: Those who see the blade open fall into illusion: lost, they turn on each other.
pipican.soul.path.perfect_lie.s7: Black coffin: traps the creature you look at and crushes it.
pipican.soul.path.perfect_lie.s10: Butterfly evolution: wings, constant regeneration, and you come back once from a deadly blow.
pipican.soul.path.perfect_lie.armor: A white commander's robe: 15% of attacks hit only an illusion.
pipican.soul.path.cherry_storm.s3: A thin cloud of petals from the blade's tip.
pipican.soul.path.cherry_storm.s5: The blade scatters into a thousand petal-blades, sent where you look.
pipican.soul.path.cherry_storm.s7: Pillars of a thousand blades all around: everything near you is cut, every second.
pipican.soul.path.cherry_storm.s10: All petals gather into one white blade; wings of light on your back.
pipican.soul.path.cherry_storm.armor: A noble white scarf: you shrug off knockback.
pipican.soul.path.snow_dragon.s3: An ice chain catches the creature you look at and drags it to you.
pipican.soul.path.snow_dragon.s5: A chained crescent blade: loose an ice dragon that freezes what it hits.
pipican.soul.path.snow_dragon.s7: Ice wings and tail; twelve petals count your time down.
pipican.soul.path.snow_dragon.s10: Adult form: no time limit for 2 minutes, and everything you touch freezes at once.
pipican.soul.path.snow_dragon.armor: Winged ice-crystal armor: cold can't touch you and attackers are chilled.
pipican.soul.path.snow_dragon.aura: Frost around you slows your foes.
pipican.soul.path.unchained_beast.s3: For 15 seconds the more you are hurt, the harder you hit.
pipican.soul.path.unchained_beast.s5: The blade turns into a giant cleaver: one swing that mows down heavy creatures.
pipican.soul.path.unchained_beast.s7: Beast form, a crimson aura: the lower your health, the more your damage multiplies.
pipican.soul.path.unchained_beast.s10: Every limit gone for 30 seconds: no protection at all, enormous damage.
pipican.soul.path.unchained_beast.armor: A torn haori with bells: strength while below half health.
pipican.soul.path.unchained_beast.aura: Your presence weakens the creatures around you.
pipican.soul.path.playful_shadow.s3: Twin blades: for 10 seconds every hit strikes twice.
pipican.soul.path.playful_shadow.s5: Rules of the game: step through the shadows behind the creature you look at; your next hit deals half again.
pipican.soul.path.playful_shadow.s7: A drama in four acts: the creature you look at is bound by threads, slowed, and shares every wound you take.
pipican.soul.path.playful_shadow.s10: Final act: every bound foe is finished in a single blow.
pipican.soul.path.playful_shadow.armor: A straw hat over a flowered kimono: hidden in the dark while sneaking.
pipican.soul.path.playful_shadow.aura: Shadows slow the foes around you.
pipican.soul.path.crimson_healer.s3: For 15 seconds your hits steal life; allies near you heal.
pipican.soul.path.crimson_healer.s5: A flying healing beast: it swallows your allies and heals them.
pipican.soul.path.crimson_healer.s7: Blood flows from the blade: your hits rot the foe and mend you.
pipican.soul.path.crimson_healer.s10: The first beast: for a minute every hit both cuts and heals you in full.
pipican.soul.path.shadow_inventor.s3: A crimson shield: extra hearts for 20 seconds.
pipican.soul.path.shadow_inventor.s5: A crimson blast where you look, and a web of shields over your allies.
pipican.soul.path.shadow_inventor.s7: Reshape: mend yourself and your allies, and break the gear of the creature you look at.
pipican.soul.path.shadow_inventor.s10: Restructure everything around you: every foe is pinned in traps.
pipican.soul.path.shadow_inventor.armor: A green-black coat and striped hat: projectiles hurt you a third less.
pipican.soul.path.scorpion_sting.s5: The needle blade: hit the same creature twice within 10 seconds and it dies (bosses take a fifth of their health). Use to dash.
pipican.soul.path.scorpion_sting.s7: A giant missile on your arm: a long-range blast where you look.
pipican.soul.path.scorpion_sting.s10: Invisible for 30 seconds, and every hit leaves a death mark.
pipican.soul.path.scorpion_sting.armor: Light open-backed assassin armor: swiftness and soft landings.
pipican.soul.path.decay_experiment.s3: Paralysing poison: for 15 seconds your hits poison and slow.
pipican.soul.path.decay_experiment.s5: The creature you look at is paralysed where it stands.
pipican.soul.path.decay_experiment.s7: A giant grub creature and a cloud of poison gas where you look.
pipican.soul.path.decay_experiment.s10: The poison adapts: for a minute it withers what it touches, and you liquefy to escape death once.
pipican.soul.path.decay_experiment.armor: A gold-black mask: poison can't touch you.
pipican.soul.path.moonlight_dance.s3: A freezing circle on the ground around you.
pipican.soul.path.moonlight_dance.s5: A white blade. First dance: a frozen circle where you look; second dance (use again soon): a wave of ice.
pipican.soul.path.moonlight_dance.s7: Absolute zero: your body freezes and everything you strike crystallises - but the cold slows you too.
pipican.soul.path.moonlight_dance.s10: Dance of death: everything moving around you is shattered.
pipican.soul.path.moonlight_dance.armor: A white ice kimono: cold can't touch you.
pipican.soul.path.moonlight_dance.aura: Snow falls around you and slows your foes.
pipican.soul.path.bone_serpent.s3: The blade grows longer for 10 seconds: you reach farther.
pipican.soul.path.bone_serpent.s5: A segmented whip-blade that lashes everything in a line.
pipican.soul.path.bone_serpent.s7: A giant serpent skeleton: an energy beam from its jaws.
pipican.soul.path.bone_serpent.s10: The bone serpent wraps your arms: for a minute your blows explode with fire.
pipican.soul.path.bone_serpent.armor: Tattooed arms and bone pauldrons: you shrug off knockback.
pipican.soul.path.bone_serpent.aura: You always reach a little farther.
pipican.soul.path.lethal_reach.s3: The blade shoots out for an instant and pierces what is ahead.
pipican.soul.path.lethal_reach.s5: The blade stretches to a great length, piercing everything in its path.
pipican.soul.path.lethal_reach.s7: The blade stretches and returns at the speed of sound, leaving a poison shard inside whatever it pierces.
pipican.soul.path.lethal_reach.s10: Every shard you left bursts from within, melting its host.
pipican.soul.path.wolf_guardian.s3: A giant ghostly arm smashes down where you look.
pipican.soul.path.wolf_guardian.s5: Summon a giant armored warrior that fights beside you.
pipican.soul.path.wolf_guardian.s7: The giant in full form - but the wounds it takes are partly yours.
pipican.soul.path.wolf_guardian.s10: Immortal for 20 seconds, then long weakness.
pipican.soul.path.wolf_guardian.armor: A wolf-headed helm and heavy plate: resistance.
pipican.soul.path.wolf_guardian.aura: You stand like a wall: knockback resistance and resistance.
pipican.ore.tamashigane_ingot.note: Use it to forge your Soul Blade and armor and choose your path - once, for life.
pipican.soul.choose: Choose the path of your soul - this can never be changed:
pipican.soul.choose_hover: Forge your blade on this path
pipican.soul.forged: Your Soul Blade and armor are forged on the path of %s. They are bound to you alone.
pipican.soul.already_forged: Your soul is already bound to a blade.
pipican.soul.need_ingot: Hold a Tamashigane ingot to forge.
pipican.soul.mined_once: The vein refuses you: a soul may take Tamashigane only once.
pipican.soul.mined: You took your one piece of Tamashigane. The vein closes behind you.
pipican.soul.spring: The River of Souls murmurs nearby...
pipican.soul.not_owner: This blade is bound to another soul.
pipican.soul.trial_ready: Your blade's spirit waits for you. Sneak and use the blade to face it.
pipican.soul.trial_start: You enter your inner world: defeat the spirit of your blade!
pipican.soul.trial_won: You have overcome your blade's spirit.
pipican.soul.trial_failed: The spirit fades - the trial is lost. Try again when you are ready.
pipican.soul.whisper: Your blade whispers its name: %s. Rename it on an anvil to name it yourself.
pipican.soul.no_name_yet: The blade has no name to take yet (stage 4).
pipican.soul.locked: Your blade has nothing to show yet (stage 3).
pipican.soul.ultimate_used: The Absolute Form is spent until tomorrow.
pipican.soul.info_none: Your soul is bound to no blade.
